title: ACT ON SPECIAL CASES CONCERNING MARRIAGE REGISTRATION
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to prescribe special provisions for cases where a party to a marriage dies without being able to report the marriage because that party participated in combat due to war or an incident, or performed official duties for the conduct of combat.

Article 2 (Marriage Report)
Where either party obliged to report a marriage dies for a reason specified in Article 1, the surviving party may report the marriage alone after obtaining confirmation from a family court.

Article 3 (Jurisdiction over Confirmation Proceedings)
Confirmation under Article 2 shall be within the jurisdiction of the family court for the place of the deceased party's last address.

Article 4 (Effect of Report)
Where a report is made under Article 2, the report shall be deemed to have been made at the time of death of either party obliged to report the marriage.

Article 5 (Scope of Application)
Matters concerning combat or official duties for the conduct of combat under Article 1 shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 2067, 1968.12.31>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 9365, 2009.1.30>
